title: Delicious Paneer Butter Masala
html:
View this post on Instagram

Creamy restaurant-style Paneer Butter Masala recipe! 🍛 Ingredients: - 200g Paneer - 2 tbsp Butter - 2 Onions, pureed - 3 Tomatoes, pureed - 1 tsp Kasuri Methi Method: 1. Sauté onions in butter. 2. Add tomato puree and spices.

A post shared by Indian Culinary (@indianculinary)
